title: Feature request: Using carelink.minimed.com or carelink.minimed.eu as a BS source, with treatments and carbs
body:
Hi,

recently we switched sensor to Medtronic Enlite sensors. We used Xdrip+ previously for remote monitoring and alarms, but we couldn't set Xdrip to show the values from this sensor.

Lastly what we managed to do, is to setup a Nightscout, which takes the data from carelink.minimed.com (US) or carelink.minimed.eu (EU region) and set as source in Xdrip+ Nightscout follower.

There should be a less complicated way to do this, ideal were to connect directly to the Medtronic CGM as hardware source, but the other method should also be good enough, to take the BS,carbs&treatments from the Carelink Minimed portal, as the Nightscout does.

thank you!

comments.body: The protocol is known, the feature could be based on (port of) https://github.com/nightscout/minimed-connect-to-nightscout

Why not follow NS and download the data from there?
minimed-connect-to-nightscout is posing as a web browser. Implementing this in xDrip may blow the app.

Closing due to inactivity.
Please respond to the suggestions and we can reopen if needed.
The enhancement will be included as soon as #1649 gets merged.
